method: Linked-channel sample peak normalization to PCM16 32767/32768 (-0.000265 dBFS). Original waveforms are preserved. At decode, playback balance uses maximum 50 ms RMS with at most 6.02 dB attenuation; never boosts above normalized peak. This is not LUFS normalization.
